name: MonarchFreshnessIndicator
title: FreshnessIndicator
summary: How fresh a data set or a sync is, such as "Updated 3 minutes ago", turning to warning and danger as it ages, with an optional Refresh button.
whenToUse: Above or below data that is synced or cached: a directory, a report, a registry import, where people need to know how old the data is and refresh it.
whenNotToUse: For the source and age of one value, use MonarchProvenance. For the outcome of the user's own edits, use MonarchSaveStatusIndicator.
api: @Composable fun MonarchFreshnessIndicator(updatedAt: Long?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchFreshnessIndicatorVariant = MonarchFreshnessIndicatorVariant.Inline, status: MonarchFreshnessStatus? = null, refreshing: Boolean = false, staleAfterMillis: Long? = null, expiredAfterMillis: Long? = null, source: String? = null, details: List<String> = emptyList(), error: String? = null, onRefresh: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchFreshnessIndicatorLabels = MonarchFreshnessIndicatorLabels())
enum class MonarchFreshnessStatus { Fresh, Stale, Expired, Never, Checking, Error }

class MonarchFreshnessIndicatorLabels(updated: ((time: String) -> String)? = null, never: String? = null, checking: String? = null, stale: String? = null, expired: String? = null, error: String? = null, refresh: String? = null, refreshing: String? = null, refreshed: String? = null, refreshFailed: String? = null)

options.name: updatedAt
options.description: When the data was last updated or synced, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). null means never.

options.name: variant
options.description: Inline is a line of muted text; Banner is a bordered bar.

options.name: status
options.description: Replaces the status worked out from the age, for example Checking or Error.

options.name: refreshing
options.description: A refresh the app runs is in progress; the button is busy and ignores taps. When it turns false the outcome is announced.

options.name: staleAfterMillis
options.description: The age after which the data is stale (warning). null never turns stale.

options.name: expiredAfterMillis
options.description: The age after which the data is expired (danger). null never expires.

options.name: source
options.description: Names the data or its source, shown first.

options.name: details
options.description: Further facts appended with middle dots. Empty strings are left out.

options.name: error
options.description: The error text for the error status. Without it "Status unavailable" is shown.

options.name: onRefresh
options.description: Adds a Refresh button. Not called while refreshing.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings monarch_freshnessindicator_*.

states.name: fresh
states.description: A dot in the success color and "Updated 3 minutes ago".

states.name: stale
states.description: A warning dot and "Out of date" in semibold warning text after the time.

states.name: expired
states.description: A danger dot and "Very out of date" in semibold danger text after the time.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger dot and the error text, after the time when there is one.

states.name: refreshing
states.description: The Refresh button shows progress, ignores taps and has the state "Refreshing".

appearance: Caption text in the muted text color after a small dot in the solid color of the status tone (subtle text for never). Flags and errors use the strong color of the tone at semibold weight. The banner adds the subtle background and the subtle border with large rounded corners. The Refresh button is a small ghost MonarchButton. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web onRefresh can return a promise that keeps the button busy; here the app controls refreshing, and when it turns false "Refreshed." is announced, or "Refresh failed." when the status is then Error. The web wakes up exactly when a limit is passed; here the status and the relative time are worked out again every minute, so a change can show up to a minute late. The web actions slot and the live and now options are not offered: place other controls beside the indicator. The web retry glyph on the button is not drawn, because Monarch bundles no icons. Times are epoch milliseconds, formatted with DateUtils. iOS shares the name and the statuses and takes an async onRefresh.
accessibility: The dot and the line are one TalkBack element, read with commas between the parts: "Directory, Updated 3 minutes ago, Out of date".
The status is written in words ("Out of date", "Very out of date", the error), so the color of the dot is never the only signal.
A change to stale, expired or error after the first composition is announced through a polite live region; the first status is not announced.
When refreshing turns false, "Refreshed." or "Refresh failed." is announced through the same live region.
The Refresh button is a separate element with a 48dp touch target; while refreshing it ignores taps and has the state "Refreshing".
The button moves under the line when both do not fit, so nothing is cut off at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Without either limit the data never turns stale.
status = Error with no updatedAt shows only the error text.
Two refreshes in a row announce "Refreshed." each time: the live region is emptied for a frame before the words are set again.

examples.title: Banner with refresh
examples.template:
MonarchFreshnessIndicator(
    updatedAt = updatedAt,
    variant = MonarchFreshnessIndicatorVariant.{{variant|pascal}},
    refreshing = refreshing,
    staleAfterMillis = {{staleAfterSeconds}} * 1000L,
    expiredAfterMillis = {{expiredAfterSeconds}} * 1000L,
    source = {{source}},
    details = listOf({{details.0}}),
    onRefresh = { refreshing = true },
    actions = {
        MonarchLink(text = {{manageSource}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline)
    },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
val updatedAt = remember { System.currentTimeMillis() - {{updatedHoursAgo}} * 60 * 60 * 1000L }
var refreshing by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
examples.setup:
val updatedAt = remember { System.currentTimeMillis() - 5 * 60 * 60 * 1000L }
var refreshing by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
examples.code:
MonarchFreshnessIndicator(
    updatedAt = updatedAt,
    variant = MonarchFreshnessIndicatorVariant.Banner,
    refreshing = refreshing,
    staleAfterMillis = 3600 * 1000L,
    expiredAfterMillis = 86_400 * 1000L,
    source = "Directory",
    details = listOf("Live updates on"),
    onRefresh = { refreshing = true },
    actions = {
        MonarchLink(text = "Manage source", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline)
    },
)

examples.title: A banner while the status is read
examples.code:
MonarchFreshnessIndicator(
    updatedAt = null,
    variant = MonarchFreshnessIndicatorVariant.Banner,
    status = MonarchFreshnessStatus.Checking,
)
